status: Recorded proposals for a later cycle; not accepted runtime features and no experiments authorized by this record.

ideas.hypothesis: Replace a complete k-partite certificate by a k-clique anchor plus sound forced-color propagation: with exactly k colors, any remaining vertex adjacent to all but one established color is forced. If every vertex is forced, verify full sample constraints on the sole candidate.
ideas.motivation: A polynomial sufficient certificate may need fewer observed cross-pair edges, addressing sparse coverage without exhaustive coloring.
assumptions: all graph edges are sound cannot-links in the declared model
full positive and negative checks remain mandatory
ideas.boundary: Not a proof of all uniquely colorable graphs; not valid for unknown k merely from a k-clique.

ideas.hypothesis: For equal-size blocks, let ui be two repeats of each block's symbol list and vi=ui+first_symbol. Try only three positives: forward concatenation of ui, reverse concatenation of ui, and lockstep interleaving of vi. They may give >2 cross-pair projections while every factor has exactly the two observed local words ui,vi.
ideas.motivation: Reduce the current four-positive sufficient construction to the smallest positive count that can create a strict >2 projection edge.
assumptions: finite local languages of size at most two
the construction's coverage must be proved and audited
ideas.boundary: Current adopted experiments use four positives. This proposal is not included in their reported success counts.
